name: Jahaziel
title: Benjamin's descendant and priestly servant
summary: Jahaziel is a name that appears twice in the Bible. One was a descendant of Benjamin mentioned in 1 Chronicles 8, and the other was a priest assigned the twelfth lot for priestly service under King David. Both figures play minor roles in biblical genealogies and temple organization.

keyEvents.title: Jahaziel in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jahaziel is mentioned as one of the sons of Shimei in the tribal register of Benjamin, among the family heads who lived in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Benjamin's Clan in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Jahaziel is listed among Benjamin's descendants who were family heads and lived in Jerusalem according to their genealogical records.

keyEvents.title: The Twelfth Priestly Lot
keyEvents.description: Another Jahaziel was assigned by lot the twelfth division for priestly service in the temple, as part of David's organization of the priests.

keyEvents.title: David's Organization of Priestly Service
keyEvents.description: King David organized the priests, descendants of Aaron, into 24 divisions for service in the Lord's house. Jahaziel received the twelfth lot in this arrangement.
